extension.summary: tofa media server: user interface, plus a browsable video source
extension.description:
An unofficial client for the tofa media server (tofa.tv), in two parts.
Under Programs, tofa opens a full user interface: Home, Browse, Discover, Search, title detail with cast and episodes, its own player chrome, and Settings.
Under Video add-ons, the same library appears as a browsable source, so it can also be used in widgets, favourites and Kodi's own containers.
Both play through Kodi's native VideoPlayer, negotiating DirectPlay/DirectFile so Dolby Vision, TrueHD/DTS-HD passthrough and refresh-rate matching reach it untouched.
extension.disclaimer: An unofficial tofa client, engineered with the tofa team, who also help support it.
extension.news: - Your server can now see how a Kodi stream is doing. The Activity page used to say "This client doesn't report live metrics" beside a Kodi session; it now shows the player's state, how many seconds of video Kodi has buffered ahead, and whether playback has stalled -- so whoever runs the server can tell a healthy stream from a struggling one at a glance, and has real numbers to go on when something does go wrong. Kodi cannot measure dropped frames or network throughput, so those two tiles stay empty rather than showing a guess. Everything reported goes to your own media server and nowhere else, as the Privacy page says. - Stopping playback tells the server once instead of twice. The second message was always answered "already stopped"; it is no longer sent. - Built against tofa media server 0.9.35. An older server is not refused and the add-on carries on working, but it now says so once per session, the same as it always has when it meets a server older than it was built for. Nothing else changes in this release on account of it.
